a_k_biwott: Edmund "Hollow" Biwott unpacked a bullet that missed him at S-F8. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott answered the first call, number 96 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal kept the tin.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Edmund "Hollow" Biwott listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Gideon Bao of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Edmund "Hollow" Biwott kept the tin.
deanc_67: Teodor Deanc joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Teodor Deanc during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A rat stole Teodor Deanc's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
hjalmarguldberg: Karel "Lucky" Hjalmarguldb unpacked a key to a house that is no longer there at S-F2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
simon_vylet: Gideon "Whistle" Vylet came up on Day 3 carrying news from Rosenau. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Gideon "Whistle" Vylet folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F17 and grazed Gideon "Whistle" Vylet's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges of the Hegemony (@zgeorges11).
verstlisaverst: The old hands of R-F5 have been here since Day 1. Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver has been here since Day 4. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
